name: JK to Ero Konbini Tenchou ~Arbeit Musume no Yowami o Nigitte Yaritai Houdai~
original_name: JKとエロコンビニ店長～アルバイト娘の弱みを握ってヤリたい放題～
source:
The protagonist is the manager of a small convenience store. He’s a middle-aged, single man starting to worry about his weight.  
The owner is always yelling at him about sales, and his only recent joy comes from secretly filming Yui, a high school girl who just started working part-time.  
Watching Yui change clothes or use the bathroom has become his daily routine—and his go-to material for self-gratification.  

Then, one day, disaster strikes. Yui finds the hidden camera he set up in the bathroom.  
“Manager, I found a hidden camera! Should we call the police?”  
“N-no, that’s… um… probably something the owner set up. You know, because of all the shoplifting…”  
“But putting a camera in the women’s bathroom? That’s just perverted!”  
“The owner wouldn’t do something like that…”  
“Why are you defending him!? Did you know about this!?”  
“N-no, I didn’t, but…”  
“Well, when the owner comes, I’m telling him everything!”  
(If she does that, she’ll find out *I’m* the one who set up the camera!)  

Faced with Yui’s righteous anger, the protagonist starts scheming.  
(That’s it. I’ll trap her so she can’t say a word. I’ll teach her to fear adults—using her body!)  

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=718306]getchu[/url]]
